findings: Uppercase drive letter in WSL example — Line 165 in main.py uses `/mnt/D/` instead of `/mnt/d/`. Change to lowercase: `ls "/mnt/d/3rd year"`. This prevents 'No such file or directory' errors on systems with case-sensitive mounts.

staleTime equals refetchInterval — useSystemSnapshot.js line 11 sets staleTime to 2000ms while refetchInterval is 2000ms. Reduce staleTime to 1000ms so React Query uses cache between polls instead of considering every fetch stale immediately.
